import json,subprocess
def run(raw):
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.decode().strip(),p.stderr.decode()[:200]
base={"cases":[{"primitive":"allreduce","mode":2,"root":0,"segments":1,"words":1,"capacity":1,"start":0,"events":[]}]}
tests={
 'valid':json.dumps(base),
 'empty cases':json.dumps({"cases":[]}),
 'not json':b'{',
 'trailing value':json.dumps(base)+b' {}',
 'duplicate key':b'{"cases":[],"cases":[]}',
 'bad utf8':b'{"cases":[{"primitive":"\xff"}]}',
 'missing key':json.dumps({"cases":[{"primitive":"allreduce","mode":2,"root":0,"segments":1,"words":1,"capacity":1,"start":0}]}),
 'extra key':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],extra=1)]}),
 'bad primitive':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],primitive='nope')]}),
 'mode 1':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],mode=1)]}),
 'mode 4':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],mode=4)]}),
 'root 4':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],root=4)]}),
 'float mode':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],mode=2.0)]}),
 'bool mode':json.dumps({"cases":[{"primitive":"allreduce","mode":True,"root":0,"segments":1,"words":1,"capacity":1,"start":0,"events":[]}]}),
 'segments 0':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],segments=0)]}),
 'segments big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],segments=2**20+1)]}),
 'words 0':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],words=0)]}),
 'capacity 0':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],capacity=0)]}),
 'capacity big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],capacity=4097)]}),
 'start big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],start=2**24)]}),
 'barrier words':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],primitive='barrier')]}),
 'barrier ok':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],primitive='barrier',words=0,segments=1)]}),
 'scatter k':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],primitive='reducescatter',segments=3)]}),
 'scatter ok':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],primitive='reducescatter',segments=4)]}),
 'trace big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],trace=33)]}),
 'unknown op':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'nope'}])}),
 'data p out':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}])}),
 'data count 0':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'count':0}])}),
 'data bad xor':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'xor':[[58,1]]}])}),
 'ack upto big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],segments=2,events=[{'op':'ack','rank':0,'upto':8}])}),
 'wire odd hex':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'wire','rank':0,'hex':'abc'}])}),
 'wire nonhex':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'wire','rank':0,'hex':'zz'}])}),
 'snap tag long':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'snap','tag':'x'*65}])}),
 'snap tag ok':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'snap','tag':'x'*64}])}),
 'train bad ranks':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1,'width':1,'ranks':[0,1,2,2]}])}),
 'train width big':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],capacity=2,events=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1,'width':3,'ranks':[0,1,2,3]}])}),
 'train count over':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],segments=1,events=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':2,'width':1,'ranks':[0,1,2,3]}])}),
 'reverse not bool':json.dumps({"cases":[dict(base['cases'][0],events=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1,'width':1,'ranks':[0,1,2,3],'reverse':'x'}])}),
 'cases not list':json.dumps({"cases":{}}),
 'cases 9':json.dumps({"cases":[base['cases'][0]]*9}),
 'top extra':json.dumps({"cases":[],"x":1}),
 'whitespace ok':b'  \n\t'+json.dumps(base).encode()+b'  \n',
 'too long':b'{"cases":[]}'+b' '*4194300,
}
for name,raw in tests.items():
    rc,out,err=run(raw if isinstance(raw,bytes) else raw.encode())
    ok = (out=='{"error":"invalid"}') if name not in ('valid','empty cases','whitespace ok','barrier ok','scatter ok','snap tag ok') else (rc==0 and out.startswith('{'))
    print('%-22s rc=%d %-60s %s'%(name,rc,out[:60],'' if ok else '<<< UNEXPECTED'))
EOF
